references.name: whole-station-2026
references.observed: March 2026 aerial inspected: JR longitudinal station lies between independent Scramble Square tower and western Hachiko plaza; elevated Ginza line crosses east/west beside the tower, with visible pale roof. Major station redevelopment remains unfinished. Preserve commercial towers, plazas, independent street buildings and highways; do not fabricate finished future central/west tower masses.

references.name: img-title
references.observed: Ordinary street entry photo: exposed concrete beam with broad curved haunches/columns, recessed open passage and yellow accent. Lettering, people, signage and ticket interfaces omitted.

references.name: img-outline_1
references.observed: Ordinary construction photo: white repeated M-section ribs with central valley and raised shoulders; grey roof/soffit between ribs. Roof and rib profile informs geometry; workers, cranes and temporary rail kit omitted.

references.name: JR-south-passage-2024
references.observed: Ordinary 2024 south-passage exterior photo inspected: white/grey covered platform roofs and metal frames below raised glazed passage; light grey cladding, dark glazing and temporary construction enclosure. Exact hidden JR facades/platform access arrangement is estimated. No copied scaffolding, billboards, people, brands or ticket interfaces.
